name: Primoteston Depot Testosterone 250 mg/1 ml Injectable Solution 1 Piece Primoteston
description: Injectable medication indicated for testosterone deficiency in men. Contains testosterone enanthate. Benefits: Increases testosterone levels, improves sexual function, increases muscle mass, reduces body fat. How to use: Administer one intramuscular injection. Testosterone in men plays a crucial role in the development of secondary sexual characteristics, reproductive function, and overall health. It helps maintain strong bones and muscles, influences hair growth and fat distribution, promotes sperm production, and affects sex drive, among other functions. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
